evaluation_target.rationale: The safety goal SG-1 states that the system shall prevent omitting required braking maneuvers, and the hazard describes the harmful consequence of failing to brake in time.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: The vehicle braking behavior in situations where a braking maneuver is required to avoid a collision with an obstacle or road user.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Operational situations in which the ego vehicle is approaching or encountering an obstacle or road user such that braking is needed to avoid collision, including the stated straight-ahead driving scenario with a pedestrian crossing 20 m ahead.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The concern is about whether braking is performed when needed to avoid collision; the hazard and functional requirement FR-7 establish braking-for-avoidance as the relevant system-related phenomenon.

distinctions.contrast_a: A required braking maneuver is initiated and executed in time to avoid collision.
distinctions.contrast_b: A required braking maneuver is omitted or not initiated in time, leading to collision risk.
distinctions.rationale: The evaluation target is specifically about omission of required braking maneuvers, so these states must remain distinguishable.

distinctions.dimension: Obstacle detection state relevant to braking
distinctions.contrast_a: An obstacle is detected in time for braking to be started.
distinctions.contrast_b: An obstacle is not detected, or is detected too late to support timely braking.
distinctions.rationale: FR-7.1 and FR-7.2.5 indicate that timely obstacle detection is necessary for starting braking within the required time window.

distinctions.contrast_a: The detected object is an obstacle that requires avoidance braking.
distinctions.contrast_b: The detected object is not an obstacle requiring avoidance braking.
distinctions.rationale: FR-7 and FR-7.2.2-7.2.3 distinguish obstacles and vulnerable road users from other objects for collision avoidance decisions.

distinctions.contrast_a: The object is on or close to the vehicle trajectory and at a distance that makes braking relevant.
distinctions.contrast_b: The object is not on or close to the trajectory, or is sufficiently distant that braking is not presently required.
distinctions.rationale: FR-7.2.4 requires determining distance between the vehicle and objects on or close to the trajectory, which affects whether braking is required.

orrs.obligation: The observable representation shall preserve whether a required braking maneuver is executed in time versus omitted or not executed in time.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must allow the two braking outcomes to be distinguished as separate operational states: timely braking execution and omitted/late braking execution.

orrs.obligation: The observable representation shall preserve whether obstacle detection occurs in time to support braking.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must distinguish timely obstacle detection from no detection or detection too late for braking initiation.

orrs.obligation: The observable representation shall preserve whether the perceived object is an obstacle or road user relevant to collision avoidance, and whether it is on or close to the trajectory at a distance relevant to braking.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must distinguish avoidance-relevant objects from non-relevant objects, and must preserve the relevant proximity relation to the vehicle trajectory.
